package.description: A spatial pattern analysis program for categorical maps.

en-US.description: A spatial pattern analysis program for categorical maps.
en-US.longDescription: FRAGSTATS is a spatial pattern analysis program for categorical maps representing the landscape mosaic model of landscape structure. It quantifies the spatial heterogeneity of the landscape as represented in a user-defined categorical map, computing a comprehensive set of landscape metrics for patches, classes and the overall landscape mosaic.
en-US.name: Fragstats

zh-CN.description: 面向分类地图的空间格局分析程序。
zh-CN.longDescription: FRAGSTATS 是一个面向分类地图的空间格局分析程序，用于表示景观格局的景观镶嵌体模型。它量化用户定义分类地图所代表的景观空间异质性，在斑块、类型和整体景观镶嵌体三个层次上计算一套全面的景观指标。

package.longDescription: FRAGSTATS is a spatial pattern analysis program for categorical maps representing the landscape mosaic model of landscape structure. It quantifies the spatial heterogeneity of the landscape as represented in a user-defined categorical map, computing a comprehensive set of landscape metrics for patches, classes and the overall landscape mosaic.
package.name: Fragstats
